claim_summary: For every cycle C_n of length n at least three, the number of labeled proper three-color rich-neighbor edge-colorings equals the trace of an explicit 24-state integer matrix to power n and is asymptotic to the nth power of the golden ratio.
scientific_integrity: Exact transfer-matrix proof, integer characteristic polynomial computation and direct finite checks included. Independent mathematical audit is not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only named three-color assignments of cycles are enumerated; larger palettes and colorings modulo symmetry are not counted.
The first foundational article (2024) was not accessed in full for definitive priority checking.
title: A golden-ratio law for counting rich-neighbor edge-colorings of cycles
